messages:
devon: Heads up—customer saw SCIM provisioning fail after SAML assertion came through our ingress-gateway. externalId is missing on the SCIM call and we get 400 from user-provisioner. Anyone seen attribute truncation like this?

maria: Saw the alert. Can you paste the assertion (sanitized) and the provisioning error?

devon: pasted minimal assertion here (sanitized):

```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="urn:company:extid">
  <saml:AttributeValue>eyJ1c2VyIjoiam9objpqaG9uQGV4YW1wbGUuY29tIiwgIm9mZnNldCI6ICJzdHJpbmc...TRUNCATED</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```

aj: SCIM error from user-provisioner logs: `400 Bad Request - missing externalId`. stack trace shows webhook payload lacked externalId field.

samir: Could be the ingress gateway (envoy/nginx) header/body size limit chopping long attribute values. But the AttributeValue looks base64-ish — are we encrypting any attributes before embedding?

devon: Yes — we started encoding the externalId with customer KMS wrapper (opaque token) for recent customers to avoid storing raw PII in SAML payloads. The token is ~512 bytes after encoding.

maria: If the gateway truncates at 256 bytes, that would explain the `...TRUNCATED` bit. Where is the truncation happening — before SAML validation or during header forwarding?

aj: Replayed raw incoming POST to staging ingress and captured tcpdump. Payload received by ingress clearly has full assertion. But the request forwarded to the auth service has the attribute cut off. So gateway is mutating.

devon: Which gateway? This customer uses the internal ingress-cluster with the envoy edge filter v2. We recently bumped traffic and rolled an envoy sidecar config.

samir: Envoy has `max_request_headers_kb` and `buffer_limits`. Also some filters base64-decode and put attributes into headers for authz. If we are shoving large tokens into headers, they will exceed header size and get trimmed.

maria: Good catch — our authn filter extracts `urn:company:extid` and sets `x-user-extid` header for downstream. That explains it. Putting 512 bytes in a header is not safe.

aj: Quick mitigation: switch the filter to forward the whole assertion as body to auth service and let authn service extract the attribute. Alternatively, increase header size but that is riskier. Which is faster?

devon: For immediate fix: change ingress filter to stop copying attribute into header for affected customers. I've prepared a one-line patch to the envoy config to disable `copy_extid_to_header` for the customer tenant: `envoy.filters.http.authn: copy_extid_to_header: false`

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered: staging ingress config patch queued (PR #1829).

maria: Also add a check in user-provisioner to fall back to parsing assertion body if `x-user-extid` missing, so provisioning is resilient.

samir: Long term: stop encoding large KMS tokens into SAML attributes. Use a short opaque id (e.g., 32b) that references an entry in our secure vault and avoid stuffing headers. Rework KMS wrapper to return a short handle.

devon: I'm going to roll the config patch to prod as a hotfix after review. Timeline: patch in 10m, cutover in 30m, monitor.

aj: Tests to run: replay failing customer's assertion through staging after patch, confirm downstream request contains full externalId (in body), and SCIM provisioning succeeds. I'll run that once patch is in staging.

maria: Logging action items:
- Add audit log entry whenever `copy_extid_to_header` is true for a tenant (so we don't silently enable risky headers).
- Add regression test for large attribute values in our SAML e2e.
- Create a short-lived ticket to migrate existing encoded tokens to handles (security+infra).

devon: Patch merged to staging (PR #1829), running replay now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging ingress rolled to version `ingress-2.14.1-hotfix` (sha: abc123).

aj: Replay result: provisioning success. SCIM returned 201 and user created. Downstream auth service received full assertion in body.

samir: OK we can promote to prod after a quick smoke. I'll standby for the prod rollout window.

devon: Rolling to prod now. Will post if any regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated to prod (change: disable header copy for extid). ETA ~6m.

maria: After prod rollout, let's schedule a short postmortem to discuss KMS token size limits + secure handle design. Not a blamestorm — capture decisions.

devon: Prod rollout complete. Customer confirmed provisioning backlog cleared.

aj: Closing loop: created ticket SEC-1492 (migrate-kms-encoded-extid-to-handle) and added notes to audit timeline.

samir: Nice. Action items assigned and owning tickets created. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
